notes.subject: תקדש
notes.rationale: Motsu wa qadash: 'ho halaletsa' (KJV 'be defiled', YLT 'be separated', JPS 'be forfeited') — e ka boela ea bolela ho ntshwa ho sebediswa; khetho ea Sesotho e boloka motsu oa ho halalela.

notes.subject: כלאים
notes.rationale: Mefuta e mmedi e sa tšoaneng; 'mefuta e mengata' e boharele, lentsoe le bolela lintho tse pedi tse fapaneng hammoho.

notes.subject: המלאה
notes.rationale: E bolela 'e tletseng' — kumo eohle ea peo; KGV e felisitse ka 'phofo'.

notes.subject: כרמך / הכרם
notes.rationale: Lentsoe le leng la Sesotho 'sefala' le sebetsa sebakeng sa 'vineyard' le 'garden' ka bobedi.

translation: O se ke wa jala sefala sa hao ka ⟨mefuta e mengata⟩, e se hore e ka halaletsa ⟨e tletseng⟩ peo eo o e jalang, le kumo ya sefala.
